about: Where type may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photographs run to the edges; type, labels and discs stay inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail). square is the feed post and wide the landscape cut; neither carries an interface, so both keep a 50 px top and foot, and every text column stays the reel's 858 px.
